outputs.explanation: This is a spatial image of a tissue section overlaid with cluster color-coding (micrograph/photograph type), not a plot of averaged quantitative data. The individual-data-points check does not apply.
H&E micrographs with manual region annotations (left and right). These are images, not plots of averaged data, so the check does not apply.

The panel combines an H&E micrograph with spatial gene-expression heatmap overlays (Tmprss11b, Trp63, Hnf4a) on the tissue section. Heatmap-type visualizations are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots showing running enrichment scores; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.

This bar graph shows log2 fold-change values per gene derived from a differential expression (Wilcoxon rank-sum) test comparing pooled spatial-transcriptomics spots between Tmprss11b-high and -low regions. Each bar is a single computed statistic (fold change with associated p-value) from a large-scale spot-level comparison rather than a mean across discrete biological replicates, so there is no natural set of individual data points to overlay on the fold-change bars.
